original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥孙州将扩大埃博拉防控宣传并计划推出防疫广播节目
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥孙州政府决定扩大埃博拉病毒病的公众宣传，以防止该疾病传入该州。该决定是在州埃博拉病毒病指导委员会会议上作出的，会议审查了该州的准备和应对措施。会议提出通过多语种广播和电视提高公众意识，并设立指定的紧急隔离设施。相关报道由Punch单一来源发布。

key_facts.fact: 奥孙州政府决定扩大埃博拉病毒病公众宣传
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Osun State Government has resolved to expand public sensitisation on Ebola Virus Disease as part of measures to prevent the disease from spreading into the state.

key_facts.fact: 州埃博拉病毒病指导委员会会议审查了准备和应对措施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The decision was among the resolutions reached at a meeting of the State Steering Committee on Ebola Virus Disease, where the state’s preparedness and response measures were reviewed.

key_facts.fact: 会议提出通过多语种广播和电视提高公众意识并设立紧急隔离设施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The meeting identified improved public awareness through multilingual radio and television broadcasts, as well as the availability of a designated emergency isolation facility, as urgent measures to strengthen the state’s preparedness.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未说明该州是否已出现埃博拉病例
